record.name: Threads
record.one_liner: Use the Threads API to create and publish posts, retrieve media and profiles, moderate replies, and access insights.

auth.notes: API authentication is handled by Threads user access tokens that conform to the OAuth 2.0 protocol.

access.notes: Developers can create an app and pick the Threads Use Case in the App Dashboard.

api_surface.notes: The API surface includes REST endpoints and Webhooks for Threads.
